login.title: Log in
login.intro: Enter the admin PIN chosen when this server was set up.

empty.title: No sessions yet
empty.body: A session is one room or stage with its own captions. Create one with New session.

card.clipping: The input is clipping. Lower the mixer’s output a little.
card.silent: No sound is reaching the server. Check the mixer’s output and the capture computer’s input.

links.captureHidden: The capture link carries a secret token that’s only shown when it’s made. Make a new one to see it here.
links.rotateConfirm: A new capture link replaces the old one: capture pages opened with the old link can’t reconnect.
links.captureHint: Open it on the computer that has the audio input. It stays valid until you make a new one.

form.name: Name
form.slugHelp: Goes in every link: lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
form.slugFixed: The address can’t change, so shared links keep working.
form.sourceLanguageHelp: Automatic tells English from Spanish sentence by sentence.

providerHelp.default: Gemini when a Google API key is set, otherwise local.
providerHelp.local: whisper and Ollama on this network, no internet needed.
providerHelp.mock: Scripted captions for testing, no AI.

form.targetLanguagesHelp: The original is always available too.

invalid.name: Give the session a name (up to 120 characters).
invalid.slug: Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting with a letter or digit.

form.deleteConfirm: Delete it and its captions? Recordings are kept.
form.glossaryHelp: Terms to spell right and names to leave untranslated.
form.glossaryUnavailable: Glossaries couldn’t be loaded, so only the current choice is listed.

live.reconnecting: Live status is reconnecting. Readouts may be a few seconds old.

cc.title: Captions in the live stream
cc.hint: Tip: burn one language into the picture with the overlay, and send the other as closed captions.

targetHelp.youtube_http: YouTube Studio › Go live › Closed captions › POST captions to URL.
targetHelp.obs_websocket: OBS embeds them in the stream it sends. Uses the OBS connection in Settings.

cc.youtubeUrlHelp: Paste it from YouTube Studio. It’s saved as a secret and never shown again.
cc.youtubeUrlSet: A URL is saved. Paste a new one to replace it.
cc.saveFirst: Create the session first, then edit it to add the YouTube URL and send a test caption.
cc.testHelp: Uses the saved settings: save your changes first.

palette.label: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Type a command or a session name…
